author: Mariah Joy
text: We love Keele Sanitation! Darin is the best! When we wake up early enough, he’s always so friendly and good with our dogs who greet him. We highly recommend him and Keele Sanitation!!

author: spence hogan
text:
People buy from people !
Keele Sanitation has been our garbage service for several years simply because our “Keele” guy is Darin. He is professional, personable and Dependable. Thx Darin!
Spence & Joylynn Hogan

author: Al McCallie
text:
It’s truly a pleasure to post a review for Darin at Keele Sanitation.  Darin is like a member of our family.  He is a terrific representative of the company.  We look forward to seeing him every week. He really wants us to have a great experience.  I don’t know how they find people like him.
We love Darin!

Thank you
Al & Karen McCallie
25 Post Creek Road
Cody, Wyoming 82414

author: Tanya Clifton
text: Darin has been our guy from Keele for several years. If we forget to get our bin out, he graciously gets it for us without complaint. He always stops to say hi to our dog and always greets us with a smile and a wave. He is consistent, professional, and thorough. The staff in the office is also top notch. You actually get a live human when you call. They are always kind and courteous and address my needs promptly. Highly recommend Keele Sanitarion for all your waste disposal needs.

author: Linda Cross
text: Darin has been taking care of all of our sanitation needs for  years now! He is dedicated, hard-working, super considerate on where to pull up his big truck at our house and always has a smile on his face. He is truly one of a kind. We are so fortunate to have Darin as our friendly, neighborhood trash guy.
